thread:
Ethan M.: quick ping — I'm hitting a fragment 404 from the onboarding checklist pointing to the deploy runbook: https://kb.internal/docs/deploy/kv-cache#troubleshooting. Page loads but jumps to top in the viewer. Can someone pick this up? small PR ok.
doc-link-bot: scanner: detected fragment drift. File docs/deploy/kv-cache.md header changed; original id '#troubleshooting' not found. Current header 'Troubleshooting & notes' generates id '#troubleshooting--notes'. Recommend adding explicit id or frontmatter alias to retain legacy fragments.
Kelly W.: I can patch with minimal change — prefer adding explicit anchor on the H2 so visible text stays the same: `## Troubleshooting & notes {#troubleshooting}`.
Zoe L.: I'll ripgrep for references so we don't miss hardcoded links: `rg "kv-cache#troubleshooting" -n --hidden || true`.
Ethan M.: thanks Zoe — onboarding/setup.sh and docs/onboarding/guide.md each have one hit. Please paste output into the PR so reviewers see the impact.
Kelly W.: perl one-liner I used locally: `perl -0777 -pe "s/## Troubleshooting(?!\s*\{)/## Troubleshooting {#troubleshooting}/s" -i docs/deploy/kv-cache.md` — will open PR with that and a one-line changelog.
owners-bot: CODEOWNERS note: path '/docs/deploy' owned by @eng-docs and @onboarding-squad. Owners approval will be required if CODEOWNERS matches.
Zoe L.: happy to CR once PR is up. Also suggest adding a short note in the runbook changelog explaining why we keep explicit ids (avoids future regressions).
Ethan M.: SGTM. When you open the PR, tag `@eng-docs` and `@onboarding-squad` in the description. If no objections I'll merge after owners approve and tests pass.
Kelly W.: Opening PR in ~10m with ripgrep output, changelog entry, and owners tag. Ping here with the link for review. :rocket:
